build_dataset: build a dataset by name, config, and split (train, val, or test) using the DATASET_REGISTRY
create_DATASET_REGISTRY: create a DATASET_REGISTRY for registering dataset classes callable with cfg and split
test_build_dataset: test the build_dataset function with a dataset name, config, and split argument
refactor_build_dataset: refactor build_dataset to handle dataset name capitalization and registry lookup
review_DATASET_REGISTRY: review the DATASET_REGISTRY pattern for registering and retrieving dataset classes
